title: WWTP — overview
description: The plant at a glance. Generated from contracts/tags.yaml; the band on each panel is the contract's `normal_low`/`normal_high`, which is a *specification* and not an alarm threshold — see docs/ALARM-TUNING.md.

panels.title: Influent and effluent flow
panels.description: Two different quantities on one axis is wrong, and they are here anyway because the *shape* comparison is the point: effluent above influent means water is being added. The unit is the shared one.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'INFLUENT:FLOW:FLOW'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- flow_m3h, raw tier

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:FLOW'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- flow_m3h, raw tier

panels.title: Dissolved oxygen
panels.description: Aeration basin DO. The band is the contract's 1.5-3.0 mg/L.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'AERATION:AHU-1:DO'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- do_mg_l, raw tier

panels.title: Blower speed and air flow
panels.description: Two quantities, two units, **no band**. A threshold in rev/min drawn on a panel whose other series is m3/h is a number with no meaning, and a reader cannot tell which series it belongs to. When two units have to share a panel, the band is the thing that has to go, and the panel says so rather than implying the units agree.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'AERATION:AHU-1:BLOWER_RPM'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- blower_rpm, raw tier

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'AERATION:AHU-1:AIR_FLOW'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- air_flow_m3h, raw tier

panels.title: Effluent quality
panels.description: Ammonia and suspended solids, hourly tier, so a week on screen is 168 points rather than 12 000.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, mean AS value FROM reading_1h WHERE signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:NH4'   AND bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY time -- nh4_mg_l, hourly tier
SELECT bucket AS time, mean AS value FROM reading_1h WHERE signal_id = 'EFFLUENT:FLOW:TSS'   AND bucket >= $__timeFrom() AND bucket <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY time -- tss_mg_l, hourly tier

panels.title: Sludge and digester
panels.description: Secondary clarifier blanket depth and digester pH. No band: metres and pH are not comparable, and a blanket depth band drawn on this panel would silently be read as a pH limit. Each needs its own panel to have a band, which is a layout decision this generator makes by refusing to draw one here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'SECONDARY:SEC-CL-1:BLANKET'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- blanket_m, raw tier

SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '5 seconds', ts) AS time,        avg(value) AS value FROM reading WHERE signal_id = 'SLUDGE:DIG-1:PH'   AND ts >= $__timeFrom() AND ts <= $__timeTo()   AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time ORDER BY time -- ph, raw tier

panels.title: What has stopped reporting
panels.description: **The deadband's honest limit, shown rather than hidden.** A row exists when the value *moved*, so a signal whose value never moves produces one row and then nothing. Thirteen of the 57 signals do exactly that in a seeded week, and on a trend panel that looks like an outage and is not one. This table is why a panel that simply stops drawing is not evidence that a signal has failed — see sql/02-intermediate/02-04_gaps.md.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.id AS signal,
       s.area,
       s.unit,
       max(r.ts) AS last_reading,
       now() - max(r.ts) AS silence
FROM signal s
LEFT JOIN reading r ON r.signal_id = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.area, s.unit
HAVING max(r.ts) IS NULL
    OR now() - max(r.ts) > interval '1 hour'
ORDER BY silence DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 30
